situation.description: What the other side offered or asked

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: The tier behind this call. Stored backend-only (agent_scores); never in the card or the push (DC-4, DC-5)

field_key.description: For share_field: the share-freely field the agent is about to say

missed_preference.description: The preference the agent could not meet, shown as a flag in the live feed (DC-4 Medium). Plain language, no score.

covered_by_instruction.description: For accept or take_fallback: true when the user's own instruction during the call allows this offer although a typed rule doesn't (DC-10). Only after the user sent an instruction; never for money.

fallback.description: For take_fallback: the one fallback the offer matches, exactly as the user typed it in <fallbacks>. The system checks the offer against it and refuses the action if it does not fit, or if you name none.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: The six DC-4 answers behind the confidence tier. Logged for debugging, never shown to the user.

offer.title: HeardOffer
offer.description: The offer exactly as the other side said it, written as data. Fill a field only when they said it or it is clear from the call ("Thursday" on a call about Thursday 19 November). Leave out anything you are unsure of. Never your own judgment.

time.description: The offered start time, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 15:00 for 3pm

party_size.description: How many people the offer is for

person.description: Who it is with, as they said it, e.g. Dr. Patel

rule_evidence.description: For accept or take_fallback, when the brief has never-agree items that are not about money: one entry per item, with the business's own words saying the offer is not that thing. Ask them a question that names the item first ("Does that cake have any nuts?"). The system checks that they really said it, in answer to your question or unprompted, and that it is a no: a yes is not enough. It refuses the action until every item has it.

rule.description: The never-agree item exactly as typed in <never_agree>

business_said.description: The business's no, copied as they said it, e.g. no nuts, or none of our cakes have nuts
